results.content:
A rotation matrix transforms a vector by changing its direction while preserving its length. For example, in two dimensions, the rotation matrix \( R(\theta) \) is defined as:

\[
R(\theta) = \begin{bmatrix}
\cos(\theta) & -\sin(\theta) \\
\sin(\theta) & \cos(\theta)
\end{bmatrix}
\]

When applied to a vector, this matrix rotates the vector by an angle \( \theta \). For instance, rotating the vector (1, 0) by 90 degrees results in the vector (0, 1) [1].

results.content:
A rotation matrix transforms a vector by changing its direction while preserving its length. For example, in two dimensions, the rotation matrix \( R(\theta) \) is defined as:

\[
R(\theta) = \begin{bmatrix}
\cos(\theta) & -\sin(\theta) \\
\sin(\theta) & \cos(\theta)
\end{bmatrix}
\]

When applied to a vector, this matrix rotates the vector by an angle \( \theta \) around the origin. For instance, a vector (1, 0) becomes (0, 1) when rotated by 90 degrees, demonstrating the change in direction while maintaining its length [1].

\[
R(\theta) = \begin{bmatrix}
\cos(\theta) & -\sin(\theta) \\

\end{bmatrix}

\[
R(90^\circ) = \begin{bmatrix}
\cos(90^\circ) & -\sin(90^\circ) \\
\sin(90^\circ) & \cos(90^\circ)
\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}
0 & -1 \\
1 & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\]

この行列を使って、点(1, 0)を90度回転させると、次のように計算できます：

\[
R(90^\circ) \cdot \begin{bmatrix}
1 \\
0
\end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix}
0 \\
1
\end{bmatrix}
\]

したがって、点(1, 0)は90度回転して(0, 1)になります [1]。
